What's the difference between the Caddie Short and the Golf Short?
Fabric weight. Both share the same traditional flat-front golf silhouette, but the Caddie Short is 305 gsm organic cotton for added structure and drape, while the Golf Short is 195 gsm and built lighter for warm-weather rounds.

GOTS Certified

products.body_html:
Made from 200 gsm RWS-certified merino jersey and sewn in Portugal. Naturally regulates temperature, manages moisture, and resists odor. Soft hand feel, refined drape, and enough natural elasticity for unrestricted movement. Self-fabric collar, three-button placket, side vents, and subtle sleeve embroidery. FAQ

Is merino wool good for golf in the summer?
Yes. Merino's fiber structure regulates temperature in both directions, wicking moisture away from the body in heat and retaining warmth in cooler conditions. It's a common misconception that wool is only for cold weather; our 200gsm merino jersey is built specifically to perform across a full round in changing temperatures.

What does RWS-certified mean?
RWS (Responsible Wool Standard) certifies that the wool comes from farms meeting defined animal welfare and land management requirements and that the fiber is tracked through the supply chain to the finished garment.

products.title: ORGANIC VENTILE JACKET
products.body_html:
Made from organic Ventile cotton and sewn in Portugal. Originally developed in Britain during the Second World War for Royal Air Force pilots, Ventile is densely woven for natural resistance to wind and rain. When exposed to moisture, the cotton fibers swell, tightening the fabric while allowing it to remain breathable.

Lightweight and cut in a relaxed silhouette. Built for windy mornings on the course, coastal weather, travel, and everyday wear.

Every Ventile garment is backed by our lifetime guarantee. If something goes wrong, we’ll make it right and repair it when possible.

Model is 6'1" and is wearing a size L.

Specifications

  • Organic Ventile cotton shell
  • Ventile fabric woven in Switzerland
  • Made in Portugal
  • Organic cotton lining
  • Relaxed fit with raglan sleeves
  • Two-way YKK zipper
  • Zippered hand pockets
  • Adjustable snap cuffs
  • Naturally wind resistant
  • Water resistant without synthetic membranes or coatings
  • Highly breathable

Contents

Shell: 100% organic cotton Ventile. Lining: 100% organic cotton.

Care

Machine wash cold when necessary. Hang dry. Do not tumble dry. Reproofing may be required over time to maintain water resistance.

FAQ

What is Ventile fabric?
Ventile is a densely woven, 100% cotton fabric developed in Britain during WWII for RAF pilots. Rather than relying on a synthetic membrane or coating, its cotton fibers swell when wet, tightening the weave and increasing water resistance while the fabric stays breathable.

Is Ventile actually waterproof?
It's water-resistant rather than fully waterproof; it holds up well in wind and light-to-moderate rain, and its resistance improves as the fibers swell with moisture. It will need occasional reproofing to maintain that performance over time.

Care

FAQ

Are corduroy shorts appropriate for golf?
Fine-wale corduroy is a lighter-weight, more tailored version of the fabric than the wide-wale corduroy most people picture, which is what makes it work as a golf short. Ours is finished with a pressed front crease for a clean, on-course appearance.

GOTS Certified

Our organic cotton is GOTS-certified, tracked from raw fiber to finished fabric under the Global Organic Textile Standard, the leading certification for organic textile processing.

The certification governs three things: restricted chemical use (no toxic chemicals or heavy metals in processing), wastewater treatment and environmental management at the mill, and labor conditions in the facilities that make the fabric.
